segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the device as too harsh, with one describing breakouts and another needing to drop settings and pause use due to dryness and irritation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report increased dryness and needing to take breaks, though one also reports plumper-looking skin once use was reduced.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 60s with mature skin and few signs of aging reports visible results and considers it worth adding to her routine.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and smile lines report visible softening within one to three weeks and firmer, plumper-looking skin; one older reviewer confirms results even with already minimal signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports her skin became noticeably dry after daily use and improved once she reduced frequency; another notes dry skin is required for one of the modes, which some found uncomfortable.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the device burned her skin and caused persistent redness and tingling; another reports it caused red pimple bumps she does not normally get.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the device destroyed her skin barrier and triggered unusual breakouts; no other reviewer reports barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the device left dark spots or burns on skin (including on the hand after testing), while a different reviewer reports the device made existing dark spots less noticeable.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some note reduced acne swelling, but three reviewers explicitly report new breakouts or acne-like bumps after use, and one calls Medicube's other products acne-triggering by contrast.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer discusses oiliness or oil control in relation to this device.
